anchor.problem: Choose which immutable-base legal critical-driver replacement to measure, then return a measured candidate with useful timing-quality/cost tradeoff.
anchor.engineering_user: Timing-optimization developer using a local arrival-scoring replacement consumer.
anchor.downstream_need: Reduce fully charged measured-selection time at justified local-regret and global WNS/TNS/ERC tolerances; utility remains unverified.
anchor.causal_mechanism: Signed candidate-minus-base electrical sensitivities parameterize shared residual contrast covariance; bundled measurements update the table used by a bounded regret-per-cost controller.
mechanism_invariants: Same immutable checkpoint and ordered legal alternatives for every baseline/query.
Candidate contrasts, not dense full-vector outputs or generic shared exact execution.
No future labels or unavailable stage information in unmeasured inputs.
Reference query bundles objective/constraint results and verifies restoration.
Only measured candidates may be returned; final full guards; no exact best-choice or probabilistic-coverage claim.
Same-feature joint and latent-factor GP with same controller are mandatory strongest comparisons.
Global timing/electrical utility and complete cost ledger remain necessary.
forbidden_pivots: Adding agents, training data or extra EDA trials to hide failure of contrast covariance.
Replacing the objective by RMSE without downstream demand.
Claiming exact all-candidate decisions, silicon signoff or expanded MCMM/SI/hold scope.
Resurrecting EDA-0006 generic mask-execution novelty or changing its full-vector contract under its old ID.

combination_drift.rationale: Same electrical-contrast covariance and guarded measured-selection mechanism; epsilon/D robustness and immediate caller audit preserve it. Conditional Gaussian/cost diagnostics do not replace the contribution.

demand_drift.rationale: Same timing-optimization user and fully charged global-quality endpoint; actual candidate/time headroom now explicitly required, not replaced by a variance proxy.

changes: Complete exact epsilon/persistent-D diagnostic and large-D transfer limit.
Audit immediate generator/caller and distinguish measured versus committed candidates.
Add candidate-count and charged break-even screen before implementation.
Preserve current-source/winner access limits and no-pilot gates.
revision_assessment.reason: R3 anchor-preserving analytical/source repair; useful physical system delta remains conditional; park after cycle3 if still unconverged.

resurrection_conditions: New batch authorizes exactly four additional research cycles across successors, not EDA experiments.
Any future pilot still needs source/data/adapter/owner/resource/threshold readiness, exact-task P/C agreements and independent verification.
Retain historical park, negative evidence and source/observation limits; three unsuccessful additional cycles trigger park per batch policy.
